messages:
maria_cs: Quick heads-up — after three onboarding calls this week I noticed the same feature asks popping up. Want a quick bucket so we can call out renewal risks in next week's review. TL;DR below, please react with :thumbsup: or assign.
claire_onboard: +1 saw same in Helio & Northbay. I'll attach the short call notes.
james_prod: paste the top 3 asks here and I'll map to the roadmap/effort matrix. Also flag anything that feels like a 'renewal blocker'.
maria_cs: top asks (short):
1) per-route cost breakdown in Console — customers want per-environment and per-route toggles + simple export for finance. (severity: high for 2 accounts on renewals)
2) smarter batching suggestions — onboarding teams seeing spikes where default batch sizes blow latency; want runtime recommendations or a one-click profile. (severity: medium)
3) embeddings freshness / auto-recompute — customers ingest streaming docs and want TTL-based re-embed or scheduled refresh. (severity: medium-high)
claire_onboard: important note: Acme asked specifically for item 1 as an exec ask — renewal in ~6 weeks. I'll add the quote to the renewal deck.
nolan_eng: Qs: do we have concrete examples of files/exports they'd expect for per-route cost? Also for batching suggestions — is this a UI hint or runtime config?
maria_cs: example export = csv with columns [route, model_variant, tokens_in, tokens_out, cost_usd] per day. For batching, customers expect an opinionated default + a toggle for lower-latency mode.
james_prod: thanks. Prioritization proposal: mark item 1 as P0 for accounts with renewals in 8 weeks, item 3 as P1, item 2 as P2. Use impact x confidence to validate later.
nolan_eng: approach idea — add a small "feedback_tag" field to support tickets/ingests so we can count signals. e.g., `feedback_tag: "per-route-cost"` and `feedback_tag: "embeddings-freshness"`. We can then auto-generate a weekly signal count to feed the roadmap triage board.
claire_onboard: I'll start tagging historical tickets where feasible. Also creating a single triage issue in GH: CS/Feedback -> product-triage.
maria_cs: can you tag Acme as high-risk in the renewal sheet? I want that surfaced in the product/exec sync.
james_prod: will do. Also let's include a short mock-up for the per-route export UI in the product sync — low-effort wireframe might help close the loop.
claire_onboard: creating GH issue now and adding the call notes + a screenshot of the ask. tagging @james_prod and @nolan_eng.
nudge_bot: Reminder: CS->Product weekly sync in 2 days at 10:00 — add this thread to the agenda if there's no objection. :bell:
maria_cs: adding to agenda. thanks all.
